name: Mid-Century Modern
summary: Organic and geometric shapes in mustard, teal, orange and walnut, with slab and geometric type and wide margins. It grew from Bauhaus in postwar America and Scandinavia, and it added warmth and play to modernist order.

philosophy.core_thesis: Modernist form can be warm and humane when abstract shapes, natural materials and a small earth palette serve everyday life.
design_principles: Draw shapes from two families only: organic forms such as boomerangs, kidneys and atoms, and clean geometry such as circles and rectangles.
Limit the palette to 4 or 5 colours: mustard, teal, burnt orange, olive and walnut on warm off-white.
Set headlines in a geometric or slab face and body text in a humanist or grotesque sans serif.
Leave margins of at least 10% of the page width, and place one illustration as the focal point.
Use asymmetric balance on a 6-column grid, and tilt secondary shapes by 10 to 20 degrees.
Flatten illustration into 2 to 4 colour layers with slight misregistration of 2px to 4px.
Pair every ornament with a function: a label, a divider or a pointer.
anti_patterns: Neon or pure saturated primaries in place of muted earth tones
Dense Victorian ornament and script lettering
Glossy gradients, bevels and photorealistic wood textures
Hard black outlines of 4px or more on every shape
Centred, symmetrical layouts with equal margins on all sides
Cool grey monochrome palettes with no warm hue
Body text in condensed display faces

layout.grid_mechanics: A 6-column grid with 24px gutters and an 8px baseline; one hero shape may break the grid by up to 48px.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 35–50% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32, 64 and 96px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush left text with asymmetric balance; the focal shape sits on a third line, and secondary shapes tilt 10 to 20 degrees off axis.
layout.container_geometry: Cards use a 12px radius or a full 999px pill; panels may take organic kidney or boomerang outlines; image masks use circles.

font_pairings.note: Geometric display with a humanist text face.
A slab headline for the diner and signage register.
Wide geometric display with a plain grotesque body.
A soft serif headline for the furniture-catalogue register.

typography.tracking: Display sizes take -0.01em to +0.02em; body stays at 0; small upper-case labels take +0.08em.
typography.leading: Display 1.1; body 1.55; line-heights are multiples of the 8px baseline.
hierarchy_rules: Use weights 400 and 700 for body and labels, and 600 to 800 for display.
Use four sizes, for example 16, 24, 40 and 72px, with ratios near 1.5.
Set headlines in lower case or sentence case, and put a small upper-case label above each one.
Colour one word of each headline in teal or orange to mark the key term.

color.palette_structure: Warm off-white ground with 4 muted hues; walnut for text, mustard and orange as warm accents at 10–20%, teal as the cool counterweight.
color.contrast_rules: Walnut on cream holds at least 11:1; mustard and orange carry large type or fills only, and white type on teal holds at least 5:1.
color.surface_treatment: Flat colour fields with a subtle paper grain at 3–5% opacity; no gloss and no gradient.
color.light_and_shadow: No lit surfaces; where a shadow is needed, use a flat offset block of walnut at 15% opacity with a 4px offset and 0px blur.

materiality.surface_simulation: Printed screen-print stock and moulded plywood; surfaces imitate matte paper and do not simulate relief.
materiality.border_rules: Solid walnut lines of 1px to 2px for dividers; shapes have no outline and rely on colour fills.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; elevation uses one flat offset shadow of 4px 4px 0 at 15% walnut.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid two-colour pictograms with rounded 2px terminals, based on atoms, stars and boomerangs; outline icons use a 2px stroke.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Flat spot-colour illustration in 2 to 4 layers, stylised figures with simple geometric heads, and 2px to 4px misregistration offsets.

motion.transition_physics: Translation for screen: shapes slide in and settle with a small overshoot of 4% and no spring oscillation; layers enter in a stagger of 60ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover tilts a shape by 3 degrees and shifts the offset block by 2px; active returns it to 0 degrees with a mustard fill.

emotion.target_response: Optimism with ease: the viewer feels welcome, relaxed and confident in a well-made, human-scaled world.

avoid_when: The product is a dense data tool that needs a neutral grid and a monochrome palette.
The brand must feel futuristic, cold or high-tech.
The audience expects a sharp, high-contrast, brutalist voice.

modifiers.how: Move to a 12-column grid, drop to one typeface and one accent, and set the radius to 0px; keep the cream ground.
Cut the palette to red, blue and yellow with black, replace organic shapes with circle, square and triangle; keep the asymmetry.
Raise saturation of mustard and orange to #FF6A00 and magenta, add concentric wavy outlines; keep the flat layers and the geometric type.
Add pink and black with squiggle and confetti patterns on 3px outlines; keep the flat fills and the tilted blocks.

pack.why: Solid forms with soft corners: the organic silhouette of the period, with no outline.

ground.why: Mid-century print sits on warm uncoated stock, with flat colour that soaks into the grain.
